JOIN "district" d ON sd.District_ID = d.District_ID;

votes.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.product AS scanner_model,
       d.district_name AS district,
       p.pages_per_minute_color AS manufacturing_capacity
FROM "product" p
JOIN "store_product" sp ON p.product_id = sp.product_id
JOIN "store" s ON sp.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN "store_district" sd ON s.store_id = sd.store_id
JOIN "district" d ON sd.district_id = d.district_id;

SELECT d."District_name", p."product", p."pages_per_minute_color" AS "manufacturing_capacity"
FROM "product" p
JOIN "store_product" sp ON p."product_id" = sp."Product_ID"
JOIN "store" s ON sp."Store_ID" = s."Store_ID"
JOIN "store_district" sd ON s."Store_ID" = sd."Store_ID"
JOIN "district" d ON sd."District_ID" = d."District_ID"

SELECT p."product" AS scanner_model, d."District_name" AS district, COUNT(*) AS manufacturing_capacity FROM "product" p JOIN "store_product" sp ON p."product_id" = sp."Product_ID" JOIN "store" s ON sp."Store_ID" = s."Store_ID" JOIN "store_district" sd ON s."Store_ID" = sd."Store_ID" JOIN "district" d ON sd."District_ID" = d."District_ID" GROUP BY p."product", d."District_name";

votes.sql:
WITH max_pop AS (
    SELECT MAX(City_Population) AS max_pop FROM "district"
),
top_districts AS (
    SELECT "District_ID" FROM "district", max_pop WHERE City_Population = max_pop.max_pop
),
 dpi_counts AS (
    SELECT p.dpi, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM "store" s
    JOIN "store_district" sd ON s.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
    JOIN top_districts td ON sd.District_ID = td.District_ID
    JOIN "store_product" sp ON s.Store_ID = sp.Store_ID
    JOIN "product" p ON sp.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
    GROUP BY p.dpi
),
 max_cnt AS (
    SELECT MAX(cnt) AS max_cnt FROM dpi_counts
)
SELECT dpi FROM dpi_counts, max_cnt WHERE cnt = max_cnt.max_cnt;

SELECT p.dpi FROM product p JOIN store_product sp ON p.product_id = sp.Product_ID JOIN store_district sd ON sp.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID JOIN district d ON sd.District_ID = d.District_ID WHERE d.District_ID IN (SELECT District_ID FROM district ORDER BY City_Population DESC LIMIT 10) GROUP BY p.dpi ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH "max_pop_dist" AS (
  SELECT "District_ID"
  FROM "district"
  WHERE "City_Population" = (SELECT MAX("City_Population") FROM "district")
),
"stores_in_max" AS (
  SELECT "Store_ID"
  FROM "store_district"
  JOIN "max_pop_dist" ON "store_district"."District_ID" = "max_pop_dist"."District_ID"
),
"product_counts" AS (
  SELECT p."dpi", COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM "store_product" sp
  JOIN "stores_in_max" si ON sp."Store_ID" = si."Store_ID"
  JOIN "product" p ON sp."Product_ID" = p."Product_ID"
  GROUP BY p."dpi"
),
"max_cnt" AS (
  SELECT MAX(cnt) AS max_cnt FROM "product_counts"
)
SELECT dpi
FROM "product_counts", "max_cnt"
WHERE cnt = max_cnt.max_cnt;

SELECT DISTINCT d."District_name", d."Headquartered_City"
FROM "product" p
JOIN "store_product" sp ON p."product_id" = sp."Product_ID"
JOIN "store_district" sd ON sp."Store_ID" = sd."Store_ID"
JOIN "district" d ON sd."District_ID" = d."District_ID"
WHERE p."product" = 'Fujitsu fi-6130 A4 Series Scanner';

SELECT d.District_name, d.Headquartered_City
FROM product p
JOIN store_product sp ON p.product_id = sp.Product_ID
JOIN store s ON sp.Store_ID = s.Store_ID
JOIN store_district sd ON s.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
JOIN district d ON sd.District_ID = d.District_ID
WHERE p.product LIKE '%Fujitsu fi-6130%'

FROM product p
JOIN store_product sp ON p.product_id = sp.Product_ID
JOIN store s ON sp.Store_ID = s.Store_ID
JOIN store_district sd ON s.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
JOIN district d ON sd.District_ID = d.District_ID
WHERE s.Store_Name = d.Headquartered_City;

votes.sql:
WITH sales AS (
    SELECT sd."District_ID",
           p."product",
           COUNT(*) AS units_sold
    FROM "store_product" sp
    JOIN "store" s ON sp."Store_ID" = s."Store_ID"
    JOIN "store_district" sd ON s."Store_ID" = sd."Store_ID"
    JOIN "product" p ON sp."Product_ID" = p."product_id"
    GROUP BY sd."District_ID", p."product_id"
)
SELECT product
FROM (
    SELECT product,
           District_ID,
           units_sold,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY District_ID ORDER BY units_sold DESC) AS rn
    FROM sales
) sub
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH product_counts AS (

        d.District_name,
        p.product,
        COUNT(*) as product_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.District_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, p.product ASC) as rn

    JOIN store_district sd ON sp.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
    JOIN district d ON sd.District_ID = d.District_ID
    GROUP BY d.District_ID, d.District_name, p.product_id, p.product
)

FROM product_counts
WHERE rn = 1

JOIN store_district sd ON s.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
JOIN district d ON sd.District_ID = d.District_ID;

WITH max_dpi_per_district AS (
    SELECT sd."District_ID", MAX(p.dpi) AS max_dpi
    FROM "product" p
    JOIN "store_product" sp ON p."product_id" = sp."Product_ID"
    JOIN "store" s ON sp."Store_ID" = s."Store_ID"
    JOIN "store_district" sd ON s."Store_ID" = sd."Store_ID"
    GROUP BY sd."District_ID"
),
filtered_scanners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.*, sd."District_ID"
    FROM "product" p
    JOIN "store_product" sp ON p."product_id" = sp."Product_ID"
    JOIN "store" s ON sp."Store_ID" = s."Store_ID"
    JOIN "store_district" sd ON s."Store_ID" = sd."Store_ID"
    JOIN max_dpi_per_district md ON sd."District_ID" = md."District_ID" AND p.dpi = md.max_dpi
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT "District_ID",
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "City_Area" DESC) AS district_rank
    FROM "district"
)
SELECT f."product" AS product,
       f.dpi,
       f.pages_per_minute_color,
       f.interface,
       d."District_name" AS district_name,
       rd.district_rank,
       SUM(f.pages_per_minute_color) OVER (
           PARTITION BY f.interface
           ORDER BY rd.district_rank
           ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
       ) AS running_total_pages_per_minute
FROM filtered_scanners f
JOIN "district" d ON f."District_ID" = d."District_ID"
JOIN ranked_districts rd ON d."District_ID" = rd."District_ID"
ORDER BY rd.district_rank, f.interface;

WITH ranked_scanners AS (
    SELECT 
        d.District_ID,
        d.District_name,
        d.City_Area,
        p.product_id,
        p.product,
        p.dpi,
        p.pages_per_minute_color,
        p.interface,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.District_ID 
            ORDER BY p.dpi DESC
        ) as dpi_rank_in_district,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY d.City_Area ASC
        ) as district_area_rank
    FROM product p
    JOIN store_product sp ON p.product_id = sp.Product_ID
    JOIN store s ON sp.Store_ID = s.Store_ID
    JOIN store_district sd ON s.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
    JOIN district d ON sd.District_ID = d.District_ID
),
filtered_top_scanners AS (
    SELECT * FROM ranked_scanners WHERE dpi_rank_in_district = 1
)
SELECT 
    pages_per_minute_color,
    interface,
    SUM(pages_per_minute_color) OVER (
        PARTITION BY interface 
        ORDER BY pages_per_minute_color
        ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) as running_total_pages_per_minute
FROM filtered_top_scanners
ORDER BY interface;

WITH district_product AS (
    SELECT
        p.product,
        p.dpi,
        p.pages_per_minute_color,
        p.interface,
        d.district_id,
        d.city_area
    FROM product p
    JOIN store_product sp ON p.product_id = sp.product_id
    JOIN store s ON sp.store_id = s.store_id
    JOIN store_district sd ON s.store_id = sd.store_id
    JOIN district d ON sd.district_id = d.district_id
),
max_dpi_per_district AS (
    SELECT district_id, MAX(dpi) AS max_dpi
    FROM district_product
    GROUP BY district_id
),
highest_dpi_scanners AS (
    SELECT dp.*
    FROM district_product dp
    JOIN max_dpi_per_district md ON dp.district_id = md.district_id AND dp.dpi = md.max_dpi
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT
        hds.*,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY city_area DESC) AS district_rank
    FROM highest_dpi_scanners hds
)
SELECT
    product,
    interface,
    SUM(pages_per_minute_color) OVER (PARTITION BY interface ORDER BY district_rank ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_pages_per_minute,
    district_rank
FROM ranked_districts
ORDER BY district_rank, interface, product;

SELECT DISTINCT p.product AS product, d.District_name AS district
FROM "product" p
JOIN "store_product" sp ON p.product_id = sp.Product_ID
JOIN "store" s ON sp.Store_ID = s.Store_ID
JOIN "store_district" sd ON s.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
JOIN "district" d ON sd.District_ID = d.District_ID;

WITH max_ppm AS (
        SELECT MAX("pages_per_minute_color") AS max_ppm FROM "product"
      ),
     top_products AS (
        SELECT "product_id" FROM "product" WHERE "pages_per_minute_color" = (SELECT max_ppm FROM max_ppm)
      ),
     stores_with_top AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT sp."Store_ID"
        FROM "store_product" sp
        JOIN top_products tp ON sp."Product_ID" = tp."product_id"
      ),
     districts_of_stores AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT sd."District_ID"
        FROM "store_district" sd
        JOIN stores_with_top sw ON sd."Store_ID" = sw."Store_ID"
     )
SELECT SUM(d."City_Area") AS total_city_area
FROM "district" d
JOIN districts_of_stores dos ON d."District_ID" = dos."District_ID";
